git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Reject invalid config instead of silent default fallback

Config files that parse as null YAML (empty, comments-only) or
non-mapping values (scalars, sequences) were silently producing
BivvyConfig::default() due to serde's #[serde(default)] attribute.
In the merge path, a null overlay would also wipe out all preceding
configs because deep_merge treats non-mapping overlays as full
replacements.

parse_config now validates the YAML value before deserializing:
null and non-mapping values return ConfigParseError with a
descriptive message. collect_config_values validates each file in
the merge chain — project config rejects null, while global and
local override files skip null values harmlessly.
EOF
)"
